company.name: Axle Labs
company.shortDescription: Axle Labs is an insurance data open platform that helps to link policies and verify and monitor ongoing insurance coverage.
company.description: Axle is an open platform for consumer-permissioned insurance data. With Axle, companies can instantly verify insurance and monitor ongoing coverage, helping them create a frictionless experience for their customers and reduce operational risk through better-informed decisions.

productsAndServices.description: A service that retrieves insurance policy and coverage data directly from carriers for real-time verification.
productsAndServices.name: Axle Verification

productsAndServices.description: A policy-monitoring service that detects insurance changes and sends notifications when coverage renews, cancels, lapses, or is modified.
productsAndServices.name: Axle Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: An insurance document processing service that extracts structured policy information from uploaded cards, binders, declarations pages, and other documents.
productsAndServices.name: Axle Document AI

productsAndServices.description: A rules-based insurance evaluation service that determines whether a policy satisfies an organization’s coverage and compliance requirements.
productsAndServices.name: Axle Validation

productsAndServices.description: A hosted and embeddable interface for collecting user consent and connecting insurance accounts or uploading proof of insurance.
productsAndServices.name: Axle Ignition

productsAndServices.description: An API that enables applications to retrieve standardized insurance policy information and receive policy-related events.
productsAndServices.name: Axle API
